blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu Gov. Pamela Baricuatro has approved a province-wide El Niño preparedness plan that readies water-rationing schedules, tanker deployments, and emergency deep wells, as forecasters warn the current dry spell could intensify into a “very strong” El Niño by year-end.
